args.lesson: For bursty Poisson 8-req bursts (2 req/us, p99<=0.4us) with min LUTs+FFs: pipelined_m dominated the front (m=4..7, dw=15..20, n_iter=12..13); winner pipelined_m dw=15/n_iter=12/m=7 (est 816 LUTs+FFs, 10.1 bits, sim p99 0.233us). L1 analytic p99 bounds under-predicted simulated p99 by ~1.4-1.5x (0.168->0.233) but all top-5 still passed. No recorded L3/L4 rows for pipelined_m designs, so no measured confirmation.
